description: This file contains API function declarations related to managing host objects and their IP addresses within the COSA Data Model library. It defines functions for retrieving, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back host configurations, including IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
external_files: some standard headers likely included in implementation (.c) files, but not explicitly shown here

methods.name: Hosts_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for the Hosts object.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of host entries.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific host entry by index.

methods.name: XHost_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the host entry has been updated.

methods.name: XHost_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes host data, possibly with an underlying data store.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a boolean parameter value for a host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Gets an integer parameter value for a host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets a ULONG parameter value for a host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a host.

methods.name: XHost_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a host.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of IPv4 addresses for a host.

methods.description: Retrieves an IPv4 address entry by index.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of an IPv4 address parameter.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetEntryCount
